name: search_pattern_map
description: Plots the search pattern onto a map. Call this function whenever appropriate.

location.description: Commence search point of the search.

name: survivor_status_calculation
description: Calculates the estimated survival time of a survivor based on environmental conditions.

survivor_condition.description: Initial condition of the survivor (e.g., healthy, injured).

additional_factors.description: Additional factors that may impact the survival time, such as dangerous animals.

name: weather_forecast
description: Generates a weather forecast for search and rescue operations.

forecast_duration.description: Duration of the forecast in hours.

name: survivor_location_calculation
description: Calculates the location of a survivor based on last known position and drift.

last_known_position.description: Last known position of the survivor (e.g., latitude, longitude).

drift_speed.description: Speed of the drift in knots.

drift_direction.description: Direction of the drift (e.g., N, S, E, W).

name: sunset
description: Estimates the local time the sun sets.

position.description: Estimated position of the survivor (e.g., latitude, longitude).

name: sunrise
description: Estimates the local time the sun rises.

position.description: Estimated position of the survivor (e.g., latitude, longitude).

name: ais_vessel_tracking
description: Retrieves real-time AIS data for nearby vessels to assist coordination and identify potential rescuers.

area.description: Geographic area to query for AIS data.

time_window.description: Time window in hours for historical vessel positions.

name: emergency_communication_relay
description: Sends emergency messages to relevant authorities or nearby vessels.

recipient.description: Target recipient (e.g., coast guard, nearby vessel).

name: sar_asset_availability
description: Checks availability and ETA of SAR assets (e.g., helicopters, rescue boats).

asset_type.description: Type of asset (e.g., helicopter, fast rescue craft).

name: detection_probability_estimator
description: Estimates the probability of detecting a survivor based on search pattern, visibility, and sea state.

name: medical_triage_advisor
description: Provides triage recommendations based on survivor condition and available resources.

survivor_condition.description: Condition of the survivor (e.g., hypothermia, bleeding).

name: visual_feed_analysis
description: Analyzes live drone or vessel camera feeds to detect signs of survivors or debris.

feed_url.description: URL or identifier of the visual feed.

analysis_type.description: Type of analysis (e.g., survivor detection, debris spotting).

name: fuel_consumption_estimator
description: Estimates fuel usage for SAR vessels based on route and speed.

route_distance.description: Distance of the route in nautical miles.

name: search_area_prioritization
description: Ranks search areas based on likelihood of survivor presence and environmental conditions.

areas.description: List of areas with coordinates and metadata.

criteria.description: Prioritization criteria (e.g., drift model, last known sightings).

name: sar_mission_timeline
description: Generates a timeline for SAR operations including asset deployment, search phases, and recovery.

name: incident_report_generator
description: Creates a structured report of the SAR incident for documentation and review.

incident_details.description: Narrative or structured data about the incident.

search_summary.description: Summary of search efforts and outcomes.
